configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Set the name of the server as it appears publicly. Don't include a question mark

configurationFields.label: MOTD
configurationFields.description: Sets the player welcome message (MOTD)

configurationFields.label: MOTD Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period for display of the MOTD

configurationFields.label: Map
configurationFields.description: Sets the map for the server. If Custom is selected, Custom Map Name must also be set

configurationFields.label: Custom Map Name
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom map for the server. "Custom" type must be selected under Map, and the map files included in ShooterGame/Content/Mods. Mod Management Mode can be used for this purpose

configurationFields.label: Mod Management Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether and how mods specifed under Mods List are downloaded, updated and installed. GSCS manages = GSCS manages mods when the server is updated (can overcome failures with ARK's system, especially on Windows, but may be slower). ARK manages = the ARK server manages mods when the server is started

configurationFields.label: Mods List
configurationFields.description: Comma-separated and ordered list of IDs of mods to load (map mods will not load unless named as a "Custom" map under Custom Map Name). ONE LINE ONLY! Mod files must be in ShooterGame/Content/Mods (either manually or via Mod Management Mode)

configurationFields.label: Active Event
configurationFields.description: Sets the server's active event, if any. Some events may only work partially or not at all. Most special event assets are removed after the event. Use Custom and set Custom Event Name for an event not listed

configurationFields.label: Custom Event Name
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom active event name for the server. "Custom" type must be selected under Active Event

configurationFields.label: Whitelisted Server Admins
configurationFields.description: List of [Steam64 IDs](https://steamid.io/) for whitelisted server admins. These admins do not need to use the server admin password

configurationFields.label: RCON/Server Admin Password
configurationFields.description: See the Security and Privacy menu for configurable options for the server's RCON password. The RCON password is also used in the in-game console for players to access administrator commands (unless they are whitelisted)

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password for players to join the server. Don't include a question mark

configurationFields.label: Enable Player Whitelist
configurationFields.description: If set, only players with Steam64 IDs listed under Whitelisted Players can join the server

configurationFields.label: Whitelisted Players
configurationFields.description: List of [Steam64 IDs](https://steamid.io/) for whitelisted players

configurationFields.label: Spectator Password
configurationFields.description: Sets the password for non-admin spectators on the server. Don't include a question mark

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server

configurationFields.label: MultiHome IP Binding
configurationFields.description: If required, you can change the binding of the server and RCON by changing the Application IP Binding for this instance. NOTE: The IP must be reachable by GSCS, otherwise GSCS's console won't work

configurationFields.label: Disable BattlEye
configurationFields.description: If set, BattlEye will be disabled on the server

configurationFields.label: Enable Crossplay
configurationFields.description: If set, enables crossplay between Epic Game Store players and Steam players. Do not enable Epic Only at the same time

configurationFields.label: Enable Epic Only
configurationFields.description: If set, only Epic Game Store players will be able to connect to the server. Do not enable Crossplay at the same time

configurationFields.label: Public IP For Epic
configurationFields.description: Sets the public IP for Epic Game Store players to connect to. If not set, and MultiHome IP Binding is specified but is not a public IP, then Epic Game Store players will not be able to connect

configurationFields.label: Enable Vivox
configurationFields.description: If set, enables Vivox on Steam only servers (Vivox is the default for Epic Game Store enabled servers)

configurationFields.label: Disable Valve Anti-Cheat
configurationFields.description: If set, disables Valve Anti-Cheat (VAC). Only works on PC

configurationFields.label: Banlist URL
configurationFields.description: Sets a banlist to disallow access to the server to specified players (identified by Steam64 ID). Use either the global banlist of ARK, or a custom banlist URL

configurationFields.label: Enable Admin Logging In Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, all admin commands used will be logged to in-game chat

configurationFields.label: Kick Idle Players
configurationFields.description: If set, characters that have not moved or interacted within the Kick Idle Players Period will be kicked from the server

configurationFields.label: Kick Idle Players Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period after which characters that have not moved or interacted will be kicked (if Kick Idle Players is enabled)

configurationFields.label: Auto Save Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the interval for automatic saves. 0 = constant saving, 9000000 = effectively disabled

configurationFields.label: Language
configurationFields.description: Sets the language of the server

configurationFields.label: Custom Command Line Flags
configurationFields.description: Sets custom [command line flags](https://ark.wiki.gg/wiki/Server_configuration#Command_Line) for the server (those that start with a - (dash)). Include the dash and separate with a space. Don't use flags already in GSCS's settings!

configurationFields.label: Custom Command Line Options
configurationFields.description: Sets custom [command line options](https://ark.wiki.gg/wiki/Server_configuration#Command_Line) for the server (those that start with a ? (question mark)). Include the question mark but do not separate with a space. Don't use options already in GSCS's settings!

configurationFields.label: Enable PvE / Disable PvP
configurationFields.description: If set, PvE will be enabled, and PvP disabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Offline Raiding Prevention
configurationFields.description: If set, the Offline Raiding Prevention option will be enabled in PvP mode, preventing damage to a player's structures and creatures while the player is offline. For tribe creatures and structures, all tribe members must be offline

configurationFields.label: Offline Raiding Prevention Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period after which an logged off player will be considered offline for the Offline Raiding Prevention option

configurationFields.label: Enable Hardcore Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, enables hardcore mode, meaning player characters revert to level 1 upon death

configurationFields.label: Override Official Difficulty
configurationFields.description: If enabled, sets the server difficulty level to the value set under "Difficulty Override Level". This is generally the recommended way to set the difficulty level

configurationFields.label: Difficulty Override Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the value of the difficulty level to be applied if "Override Official Difficulty" is enabled, allowing the level to go above the default 4.0. Be careful not to go too high!

configurationFields.label: Difficulty Offset
configurationFields.description: As an alternative to using "Override Official Difficulty", this setting sets the difficulty offset, which is used to calculate the [difficulty level](https://ark.wiki.gg/wiki/Difficulty)

configurationFields.label: Enable Crosshair
configurationFields.description: If set, each player will be shown a crosshair

configurationFields.label: Disable HUD
configurationFields.description: If set, the HUD (head-up display) will always be disabled

configurationFields.label: Show Player On Map
configurationFields.description: If set, shows each player their own precise position when they view their map

configurationFields.label: Allow Third Person View
configurationFields.description: If set, third person view is enabled

configurationFields.label: Show Floating Damage Text
configurationFields.description: If set, damage caused is shown in a RPG style pop-up text

configurationFields.label: Prevent Spawn Animation
configurationFields.description: If set, player characters spawn and respawn without the wake-up animation

configurationFields.label: Disable Creature Mate Boost
configurationFields.description: If set, disables creature mate boosting

configurationFields.label: Enable Hit Markers
configurationFields.description: If set, enables optional hit markers for ranged attacks

configurationFields.label: Maximum Tamed Creatures
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of tamed creatures on the server. This is a global cap

configurationFields.label: Maximum Personal Tamed Creatures
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of tamed creatures that a tribe is allowed to have

configurationFields.label: Maximum Tribute Creatures
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of slots for uploaded creatures

configurationFields.label: Maximum Structures
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of structures that can be constructed within a certain range

configurationFields.label: Maximum Tribute Items
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of slots for uploaded items and resources

configurationFields.label: Maximum Players In Tribe
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players in each tribe. 0 = no limit, 1 = tribes effectively disabled

configurationFields.label: Prevent Tribe Alliances
configurationFields.description: If set, tribes will be prevented from creating alliances

configurationFields.label: Disable PvP Friendly Fire
configurationFields.description: If set, prevents friendly fire among tribe-mates, tribe-creatures and tribe-structures on PvP servers

configurationFields.label: Disable PvE Friendly Fire
configurationFields.description: If set, prevents friendly fire among tribe-mates, tribe-creatures and tribe-structures on PvE servers

configurationFields.label: Enable PvP Gamma
configurationFields.description: If set, allows gamma changes in PvP mode

configurationFields.label: Disable PvE Gamma
configurationFields.description: If set, prevents gamma changes in PvE mode

configurationFields.label: Notify Player Join
configurationFields.description: If set, players will always be notified if someone joins the server

configurationFields.label: Notify Player Leave
configurationFields.description: If set, players will always be notified if someone leaves the server

configurationFields.label: Enable Global Voice Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, voice chat will be enabled globally

configurationFields.label: Enable Proximity Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, only players near each other can see each other's chat messages

configurationFields.label: Allow PvE Cave Building
configurationFields.description: If set, allows building in caves in PvE mode

configurationFields.label: Allow PvE Flyer Carry
configurationFields.description: If set, flyers will be permitted to pick up other creatures and players when mounted by a player in PvE mode

configurationFields.label: Allow Flyer Speed Levelling
configurationFields.description: If set, flyers can have their movement speed levelled up

configurationFields.label: Allow Cave Flyers
configurationFields.description: If set, flyers will always be allowed into caves

configurationFields.label: Disable Wild Creature Spawn
configurationFields.description: If set, wild creatures will not be spawned in the server. For an existing server, existing creatures need to be wiped with the admin command "destroywilddinos"

configurationFields.label: Prevent Hibernation
configurationFields.description: If set, creatures in inactive zones will not hibernate, at the cost of performance and memory usage

configurationFields.label: Force Wild Creature Respawn On Start
configurationFields.description: If set, all wild creatures that are not currently being tamed will be destroyed on server start

configurationFields.label: Force Wild Creature Respawn At Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the period to force respawns of wild creatures to prevent certain types (like the Basilo and Spino) from becoming depopulated on long running servers, as well as removing any lingering event creatures. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Disable Tek Railgun
configurationFields.description: If set, the Tek Railgun will be disabled in PvP mode

configurationFields.label: Disable Loot Crates
configurationFields.description: If set, loot crates will not spawn. Artifact crates will still spawn

configurationFields.label: Player Radius For No Resource Replenish
configurationFields.description: Sets the distance around players where resources are not allowed to grow back. Values higher than 1 increase it, values between 0 and 1 reduce it

configurationFields.label: Structure Radius For No Resource Replenish
configurationFields.description: Sets the distance around structures where resources are not allowed to grow back. Values higher than 1 increase it, values between 0 and 1 reduce it

configurationFields.label: Disable PvE Creature Decay
configurationFields.description: If set, the gradual (7 days) decay (or unclaiming) of creature ownership will be disabled in PvE mode. Otherwise, every creature can be claimed by any player

configurationFields.label: Enable PvP Creature Decay
configurationFields.description: If set, the gradual decay (or unclaiming) of creature ownership will be enabled in PvP mode

configurationFields.label: Enable Passive Defence Damage
configurationFields.description: If set, wild creatures and riderless creatures can take damage from passive defence structures like spikewalls

configurationFields.label: Prevent Diseases
configurationFields.description: If set, diseases will be completely disabled on the server

configurationFields.label: Disable Permanent Diseases
configurationFields.description: If set, diseases will not be permanent (they will be lost on respawn)

configurationFields.label: Allow Care By Anyone
configurationFields.description: If set, enables anyone to "take care" of baby creatures (cuddle etc), not just whomever imprinted on it

configurationFields.label: Disable Imprint Creature Buff
configurationFields.description: If set, disables the creature imprinting player Stat Bonus (where whomever specifically imprinted on the creature, and raised it to have an imprinting quality, gets extra damage/resistance buff)

configurationFields.label: Destroy Unconnected Water Pipes
configurationFields.description: If set, water pipes will be destroyed automatically after two real-time days, if unconnected to any non-pipe (directly or indirectly) and no allied player is nearby

configurationFields.label: Minimum Creature Re-upload Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the cooldown period between allowed creature re-uploads

configurationFields.label: Auto Destroy Decayed Creatures
configurationFields.description: If set, claimable decayed creatures will be auto-destroyed on load, rather than remaining around as claimable

configurationFields.label: Optimize Harvest Amount Multiplier
configurationFields.description: If set, optimizes the server performance when using a higher Harvest Amount Multiplier, by reducing the bias towards yielding rarer items

configurationFields.label: Force Flyer Explosives
configurationFields.description: If set, allows flyers to fly with C4 attached to them. Otherwise, except for Quetzal and Wyvern, they can't fly

configurationFields.label: Allow Multiple Attached C4
configurationFields.description: If enabled, more than one C4 can be attached per creature

configurationFields.label: Allow Flying Stamina Recovery
configurationFields.description: If set, flyers can recover stamina when a player is standing on them instead of riding

configurationFields.label: Disable Weather Fog
configurationFields.description: If set, fog is disabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Random Supply Crate Points
configurationFields.description: If enabled, supply drops will be in random locations. NOTE: This setting is known to cause artifacts to become inaccessible on the Ragnarok map

configurationFields.label: Allow Foreign Creature Downloads on Aberration
configurationFields.description: If set, enables tribute download of non-native creatures on the Aberration map

configurationFields.label: Day/Night Cycle Speed Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for the server day/night cycle. The default value 1 sets the same speed as a singleplayer game, ie 1 minute real time = approx 28 minutes server time. A scale of 0.035 would set a day/night cycle of approx 24 hours real time

configurationFields.label: Day Time Speed Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for the length of each server day, relative to the length of each night. Lowering this value increases the day length

configurationFields.label: Night Time Speed Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for the length of each server night, relative to the length of each day. Lowering this value increases the night length

configurationFields.label: XP Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for experience (XP) received by players, tribes and creatures for various actions. The default value 1 provides the same experience as a singleplayer game. Higher values increase XP amounts awarded, lower values decrease it

configurationFields.label: Player Food Drain Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for player characters' food consumption. Higher values increase food consumption (player characters get hungry faster)

configurationFields.label: Player Water Drain Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for player characters' water consumption. Higher values increase water consumption (player characters get thirsty faster)

configurationFields.label: Player Health Recovery Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for player characters' health recovery. Higher values increase the recovery rate (player characters heal faster)

configurationFields.label: Player Stamina Drain Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for player characters' stamina consumption. Higher values increase stamina consumption (player characters get tired faster)

configurationFields.label: Player Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for the damage that players cause with their attacks. The default value 1 causes normal damage. Higher values increase damage, lower values decrease it

configurationFields.label: Player Resistance Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for players' damage resistance when attacked. The default value 1 causes normal damage. Higher values decrease resistance, increasing damage per attack. Lower values increase it, reducing damage per attack

configurationFields.label: Creature Food Drain Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for creatures' food consumption. Higher values increase food consumption (creatures get hungry faster)

configurationFields.label: Creature Health Recovery Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for creatures' health recovery. Higher values increase the recovery rate (creatures heal faster)

configurationFields.label: Creature Stamina Drain Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for creatures' stamina consumption. Higher values increase stamina consumption (creatures get tired faster)

configurationFields.label: Creature Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for the damage that wild creatures cause with their attacks. The default value 1 causes normal damage. Higher values increase damage, lower values decrease it

configurationFields.label: Creature Resistance Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for wild creatures' damage resistance when attacked. The default value 1 causes normal damage. Higher values decrease resistance, increasing damage per attack. Lower values increase it, reducing damage per attack

configurationFields.label: Creature Spawn Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for creature spawns. Higher values increase the number of creatures spawned throughout the server

configurationFields.label: PvE Creature Decay Period Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Set the scaling factor for the unclaiming speed of creatures in PvE mode

configurationFields.label: Structure Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for the damage that structures (spikewalls) cause with their attacks. The default value 1 causes normal damage. Higher values increase damage, lower values decrease it

configurationFields.label: Structure Resistance Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for structures' damage resistance when attacked. The default value 1 causes normal damage. Higher values decrease resistance, increasing damage per attack. Lower values increase it, reducing damage per attack

configurationFields.label: PvE Structure Decay Period Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for the decay rate of player structures in PvE mode

configurationFields.label: Maximum Platform Structures Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for the maximum number of structures placeable on platform saddles and rafts. NOTE: high values may lead to lag

configurationFields.label: Auto Structure Destruction Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor, relative to the period for allowing claims, to automatically destroy structures if there has been no near tribe player during that time

configurationFields.label: Harvest Amount Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for yields from all harvesting activities (chopping down trees, picking berries, carving carcasses, mining rocks, etc). Higher values increase the amount harvested with each strike

configurationFields.label: Harvest Health Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for the "health" of harvestable items (trees, rocks, carcasses, etc). Higher values increase the number of strikes needed to destroy them, increasing harvest yields

configurationFields.label: Resources Respawn Period Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for the resource node respawn rate (trees, rocks, bushes, etc). Lower values cause nodes to respawn more frequently

configurationFields.label: Creature Taming Speed Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for creature taming speed. Higher values make taming faster

configurationFields.label: Oxygen Swim Speed Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the scaling factor for swim speed, relative to the level spent in oxygen

configurationFields.label: Enable Structure Stasis Grid
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the structure stasis grid to improve server performance on large bases with lots of players. Structures are loaded based on grids with players. Not recommended for modded servers

configurationFields.label: Auto Destroy Structures
configurationFields.description: If set, auto destruction of old structures will be enabled. The destruction timer can be adjusted with Auto Structure Destruction Multiplier

configurationFields.label: Auto Destroy Core Structures Only
configurationFields.description: If set, any non-core/non-foundation structures will not be auto destroyed (assuming Auto Destroy Structures is enabled), except if a floor they are on is auto destroyed

configurationFields.label: Only Auto Destroy Unsnapped Core Structures
configurationFields.description: If set, only unsnapped core structures will decay (be auto destroyed). Useful for eliminating lone pillar/foundation spam on servers in PvP mode

configurationFields.label: Disable PvE Structure Decay
configurationFields.description: If set, the gradual (7 days) decay of player structures will be disabled in PvE mode

configurationFields.label: Enable PvP Structure Decay
configurationFields.description: If set, the gradual decay of structures will be enabled in PvP mode

configurationFields.label: Fast Decay Unsnapped Core Structures
configurationFields.description: If set, unsnapped foundations/pillars will decay at 5x speed

configurationFields.label: Structure Damage Repair Cooldown
configurationFields.description: Sets the cooldown period on structure repair from the last time damaged. 0 =  disabled (structures can always be repaired)

configurationFields.label: Maximum Platform Saddle Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of platformed-creatures/rafts allowed on the server

configurationFields.label: Platform Saddle Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of "tamed creature slots" a platform saddle will use

configurationFields.label: Override Structure Platform Prevention
configurationFields.description: If set, turret and spike structures will be buildable and functional on platform saddles

configurationFields.label: Disable Building In Rich Resource Areas
configurationFields.description: If set, completely disables building in specific resource-rich areas, in particular setup on The Island around the major mountains

configurationFields.label: Allow Crate Spawns On Structures
configurationFields.description: If set, from-the-air supply crates can appear on top of structures, rather than being prevented by structures

configurationFields.label: Allow PvE Structures At Supply Drops
configurationFields.description: If set, building near supply drop points will be allowed in PvE mode

configurationFields.label: Disable Structure Placement Collision
configurationFields.description: If set, allows for structures to clip into the terrain

configurationFields.label: Enable Cluster
configurationFields.description: If set, the use of a server cluster will be enabled. Requires Cluster Directory Override and Cluster ID to be set

configurationFields.label: Cluster Directory Override
configurationFields.description: Sets the path to a shared cluster directory for a server cluster. The cluster directory must be accessible to all cluster servers. If the server is in Docker, the directory must be mounted in the container. Requires Enable Cluster to be set

configurationFields.label: Cluster ID
configurationFields.description: Sets the cluster ID for a server cluster. The cluster ID must be the same on all servers in the cluster. Requires Enable Cluster to be set

configurationFields.label: Prevent Character Download
configurationFields.description: If set, prevents the download of characters from a cluster to the server

configurationFields.label: Prevent Survivor Download
configurationFields.description: If set, prevents the download of survivors from a cluster to the server

configurationFields.label: Prevent Item Download
configurationFields.description: If set, prevents the download of items from a cluster to the server

configurationFields.label: Prevent Creature Download
configurationFields.description: If set, prevents the download of tamed creatures from a cluster to the server

configurationFields.label: Prevent Survivor Upload
configurationFields.description: If set, prevents the upload of survivors from the server to a cluster

configurationFields.label: Prevent Item Upload
configurationFields.description: If set, prevents the upload of items from the server to a cluster

configurationFields.label: Prevent Creature Upload
configurationFields.description: If set, prevents the upload of tamed creatures from the server to a cluster

configurationFields.label: Serverversion
configurationFields.description: Sets the server branch to install. Update the server after switching branches
